en.plugins.rps.desc: Rock-Paper-Scissors (vs the bot, or 1v1 with private picks)
en.plugins.rps.usage:
*Rock-Paper-Scissors*

{0}rps - Play against the bot with buttons
{0}rps <rock|paper|scissors> - Play against the bot directly
{0}rps @user - Challenge a member (each player picks in private)
{0}rps stop - Cancel the current game
en.plugins.rps.title: 🪨📄✂️ Rock-Paper-Scissors

{0} challenges {1}!
